page.title: Readings
page.purpose: Show what each sensor currently says, whether that reading can be believed, and how the target has trended — with the trust distribution always visible beside the numbers.

regions.purpose: Present the trust triple — verdict distribution, of checked readings, of total readings — so unchecked readings can never be mistaken for valid ones.
List the current reading per target with its band evaluation, source, timestamp and trust verdict.
On the detail route, show the target's reading history re-graded against the current deadband, with untrusted readings marked and excluded from the trend.

states.description: All sources readable; readings banded and trust-qualified.
One or more readings carry a non-VALID verdict. They are shown, labelled with the specific verdict, and excluded from aggregates.
A target whose every reading is untrusted. Reported as unmeasurable with its verdict distribution — never silently absent, never shown as in band.
Single-target history view, re-graded against the current deadband.
No source could be read at all.

priorities.notes: A DEGRADED or untrusted verdict must name the offending signal and its value. TRUST-MODEL.md and CONDITION-MODEL.md agree: a bare verdict is not a valid verdict.

priorities.statement: Instrument fault reads differently from plant fault.
priorities.notes: An untrusted reading is a finding about the sensor, not about the platform. The two must never share a visual treatment, or an operator will schedule plant work for an instrument defect.
Band evaluation is computed against the current deadband at view time, so a tightened target re-grades its own history rather than showing stale judgments.

claims.statement: The trust distribution is displayed as a triple — verdicts, of checked readings, of total readings — whenever any reading is shown.
claims.rationale: TRUST-MODEL.md: the board reports its own blindness alongside its findings, or it is worse than having no axis.

claims.statement: A target whose readings are all untrusted appears as unmeasurable with its verdict distribution, and never as in band or absent.
claims.rationale: A target that vanishes when its sensor breaks is the exact failure the trust axis exists to catch.

claims.statement: Every out-of-band or untrusted verdict displays the offending signal and its observed value.
claims.rationale: A bare verdict cannot be acted on and cannot be audited back to evidence.

claims.statement: Instrument-fault and plant-fault entries are distinguishable by label and shape, not only by colour, in both themes.
claims.rationale: Routing a plant fix at an instrument defect is the most expensive mistake this surface can cause.
